title: Corridor of Fate
next_chapter_hook: At the end of the corridor, that figure slowly turned around, and between the brows and eyes, it was remarkably similar to Chen Ji—is this a jest of fate, or the deepest layout of the Tianji Record?

text.content: Behind the sealed door was not the secret realm imagined, but a deep and endless corridor. On the stone walls on both sides were carved obscure and incomprehensible runes, each pattern emanating a faint fluorescent glow, like a star river that had slumbered for a thousand years. Chen Ji stood at the entrance, feeling that familiar pressure spreading from the depths of the corridor, forming some kind of eerie resonance with the fluctuations of the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying rare gravity: "Corridor of Fate... the burial place of prophets throughout the ages. Watch your step below, every step is a dialogue with the dead."

Ye Qing followed closely behind, the veil of the Demonic Path Saint floating slightly in the dim light. She looked around, frowning deeply: "This aura... is exactly like the 'Ten Thousand Eras Corridor' recorded in my Holy Sect's classics. Legend says that those who step into this corridor can all glimpse fragments of fate." She paused, her gaze falling on Chen Ji: "Are you sure you want to continue? The suppression here on the Tianji Record holder is more than ten times stronger than outside." Chen Ji did not answer, only gripping the fragment tighter, stepping forward.

As the footsteps went deeper, the runes on the stone walls began to shift. Those originally still patterns flowed like water, and blurry images emerged—one by one: an elderly man with white hair sighing toward the heavens, a young swordsman with blood staining the sky, and a child screaming and crying in a sea of flames. Ye Qing inhaled sharply: "Are these... prophets throughout the ages?" Chen Ji stared at those residual images, a indescribable feeling rising in his heart, as if something was awakening in the depths of his bloodline, resonating with those ancient images.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly stopped, her voice trembling slightly: "Wait... look at the brow centers of those residual images!" Chen Ji followed her gaze, only to see an ethereal golden mark on the brow center of each residual figure—the shape was exactly the same as the pattern on the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment. Ye Qing's voice was extremely low: "Legend says the Tianji Record is not a magic artifact, but... a key. The key to opening the door of fate."

text.content: Chen Ji reached out to touch the stone wall, a sting running through his fingertips. In an instant, an aged voice exploded in his mind: "Seventh generation holder... you have finally arrived." The scene shifted, and Chen Ji saw a hunched figure standing before the collapsing Tianji Pavilion, clutching a fragment exactly like the one in his arms. That figure looked up, revealing an aged and exhausted face, lips moving: "We are chess pieces of fate, and the Heavenly Dao's Eye... will never let chess pieces turn the tables."

The scene on the stone wall changed abruptly, with dozens of residual figures appearing simultaneously, densely arranged on both sides of the corridor. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—though those figures varied in era and clothing, the golden mark on their brow centers, the fragments in their hands, and even the slightly tilted head when standing were all identical. More eerily, though their faces were different, their eyes all carried the same thing: despair deep in the marrow. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again: "The Tianji Record is passed to only one person each generation, and these... are all its masters."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm: "So they all died?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "More terrible than death. All Tianji Record holders are executors of fate. We think we are foresightedly viewing the future and changing outcomes, but in truth... we are merely completing the script long written by the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Every foresight consumes Heavenly Fate Value; and when the Heavenly Fate Value is exhausted..." He paused, "that is when one is counterattacked by fate." Chen Ji looked down at his own hands, where the lines seemed deeper than before.

Ye Qing suddenly grabbed Chen Ji's sleeve, her expression complex: "Chen Ji, I didn't tell you before... the founder of our Demonic Path and the first Tianji Record holder had the same ancestor." Chen Ji猛地 turned his head. Ye Qing took a deep breath, a struggle flickering in her eyes: "That bloodline is called 'Heavenly Fate Descendant,' and those possessing this bloodline are both favorites of fate and prisoners of fate. The commander of my Holy Sect... is one of them." She stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, "You think you are a chess piece? But we... don't even have the qualification to be chess pieces."

text.content: A low rumble suddenly came from the depths of the corridor, and the residual figures on the stone walls began to slowly move. Dozens of figures walked out from the walls, like souls fished out from the river of time, completely surrounding Chen Ji and Ye Qing. The leading elderly residual figure slowly spoke, his voice like an echo from antiquity: "Successor... you have seen the truth. Now, choose. Inherit the will of the Tianji Record and step onto the path of fate's executor; or trace the source of your bloodline and seek a way to break the chessboard."

choice.prompt: The residual figures of prophets throughout the ages watched Chen Ji, awaiting his choice. Ye Qing tightly gripped Chen Ji's hand; she could feel that this man who always had strategies without flaw was for the first time truly hesitating. The gears of fate have begun to turn, and you must choose your own path.

choices.description: Inherit the will of holders throughout the ages and calmly accept the mission bestowed by the Tianji Record. Since you are a chess piece, see the chess game more clearly than the chess player, and seek that sliver of chance in the midst of despair.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value to glimpse the ultimate secret of the Corridor of Fate
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the memory fragments left by holders throughout the ages, obtaining the prototype of the 'Fate Co-Vision' skill
choices.risk_hint: May expose the connection between the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Dao's Eye, attracting more powerful attention

text.content: Chen Ji released Ye Qing's hand, stepped forward, and stared directly at the elderly residual figure: "Since Heaven's Way wants to make me a chess piece, then I shall be that pawn that crosses the river—not seeking to turn the tables, only seeking to see the entire chessboard's layout before being captured." The words fell, and the runes on the stone walls suddenly brightened, a golden light diving into Chen Ji's brow center, and countless scenes surged into his mind like a tide.

choices.description: Refuse to be manipulated by fate, and pursue the true origin of the Heavenly Fate Descendants. Only by breaking the bloodline's curse from its source can one completely escape the control of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the opportunity to explore the secrets of the Tianji Record, consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value to stabilize the awakened blood pulse
choices.visible_reward: Obtain 'Heavenly Fate Descendant' identity authentication, unlock the qualification to converse with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: Bloodline awakening may trigger the Heavenly Dao's Eye's alertness, and subsequent pursuits will become even more frenzied

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Ye Qing, his gaze profound: "Your Holy Sect Commander... I want to see him." Ye Qing shuddered all over, looking at him in disbelief. Chen Ji said calmly: "Since we share the same bloodline, the chains of fate should be broken in the same way. Will you help me?" Ye Qing was silent for a long time, finally nodding, her eyes flickering with complex light.

choices.description: While tracing one's bloodline, do not abandon any path. Two roads are not necessarily mutually exclusive; a true strong one must learn to carve out a third path in the midst of despair.
choices.visible_cost: Simultaneously consuming 15 points of Heavenly Fate to awaken bloodline resonance and memory fragments, enduring double backlash
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the content of both routes simultaneously, obtaining the hidden achievement "Twin Fates"
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, may cause Heavenly Fate to enter a dangerous range

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of madness and resolution: "Who told you I can only choose one path?" His left hand condensed golden light, his right pressed against his heart to activate the bloodline, and two powers erupted simultaneously. The old man's remnant showed shock: "This person... can actually bear two fates at once?" Golden light and blood-colored radiance intertwined as Chen Ji's body endured tearing agony, yet his gaze grew increasingly lucid.

No matter which path is chosen, the Corridor transformed the moment Chen Ji made his decision. Those remnants of past prophets slowly retreated into the stone walls, but each figure made the same gesture before vanishing—they raised their hands toward the Corridor's end, their eyes holding both compassion and expectation. Ye Qing surveyed the surroundings, voice trembling: "This path... seems to be shortening the distance between us." Indeed, the mist that had shrouded the front was dissipating, revealing a towering silhouette standing at the corridor's terminus.

Chen Ji walked forward slowly, the Tianji Record Fragment growing warm against his chest. As the distance narrowed, the silhouette's details became clearer—it was a massive bronze mirror, its surface gleaming with an abyssal luster, as if capable of reflecting the deepest secrets of the soul. The mirror frame was carved with countless names, and Chen Ji looked closely—those names were all previous Tianji Record holders. And at the very bottom, one name's position was empty, marked with a small line of text: "Seventh Generation—To Be Determined."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out, carrying unprecedented solemnity: "Chen Ji, this mirror is called the 'Mirror of Destiny.' It will reflect your true identity... including the parts you are unwilling to face." Chen Ji stood before the mirror as its surface began to ripple. Mo Xiansheng continued: "Among the past holders, some saw their past lives, some saw their moment of death, and others... saw the fate they could never escape." Chen Ji stared at the bronze mirror, voice calm: "So what?" He took a deep breath, "I, Chen Ji, never escape—it is those afraid to face the truth who do."

text.content: The mirror's surface suddenly erupted with blinding light, and Chen Ji instinctively closed his eyes. The sighs and whispers of past remnants filled his ears, mixed with the mutterings of fate. When he opened his eyes again, what reflected in the mirror was not his own face—a blurry silhouette instead. That figure's outline bore a startling resemblance to Chen Ji, yet carried a subtly different aura. More eerily, that figure's lips seemed to repeat the same sentence. Chen Ji frowned, deciphering those words: "Who do you think you are?"

dialogue.content: At this moment, a will beyond words surged from the mirror's depths, carrying the cold indifference of one gazing down at ants. An ancient voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: "Seventh Generation... another new chess piece." The voice held no emotion, yet caused every hair on Chen Ji's body to stand on end. Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in his consciousness: "It's the Heavenly Eye! It's watching this place!" Chen Ji suppressed his fear, casting a mocking smile at the mirror: "Watching me? Senior, after arranging this game for so many years, isn't it precisely to see how far this chess piece can go?"

text.content: The figure in the mirror seemed enraged by Chen Ji's attitude, its radiance surging violently. A terrifying pressure descended like a mountain, and Chen Ji knelt on one knee as the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently. Ye Qing cried out, yet the pressure prevented her from approaching. Just as Chen Ji felt his internal organs about to be crushed, a warm power suddenly surged from the fragment, rivalling that oppressive force. Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice rang out: "These are the will remnants of past holders! Quick, take this chance to ask your questions!"

Chen Ji gritted his teeth, speaking with difficulty under the pressure: "Heavenly Eye... what do you want?" That ancient voice rang out again, carrying amusement: "What I want has never been your life. A chess piece only has value when alive." After a pause, the voice turned grim: "What I want is... obedience. Every prophet throughout history has resisted, but they all eventually understood—fate cannot be escaped. The Tianji Record is my gift, and also its shackles. Break free from it, and you are nothing." A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, yet his lips curved with mockery: "Then what if... I don't even covet this shackle?"

dialogue.content: Night Qing rushed to Chen Ji's side with all her strength, demonic mist surging wildly, barely sharing part of the pressure for him. She gnashed her teeth: "Chen Ji! Are you insane! This is not the time to be stubborn!" Yet Chen Ji raised his head, directly facing the blurry figure in the mirror, his voice terrifyingly calm: "I'm not being stubborn. I'm just telling it—I, Chen Ji, never follow its script." He slowly stood up, the Tianji Record Fragment blazing with unprecedented light in his palm, "Past holders didn't dare resist because they still had weaknesses. But I..." He looked at Ye Qing, at the increasingly clear silhouette at the Corridor's end, "I have nothing, and therefore nothing to lose."

text.content: At the Corridor's end, that figure finally manifested completely. It walked slowly toward Chen Ji, each step seemingly stepping on fate's pulse. Ye Qing's pupils constricted—the figure's features were identical to Chen Ji's, yet carried an entirely different aura. It was the weathering of countless storms, the disillusionment with worldly affairs. Chen Ji stared at the visitor, his heartbeat accelerating violently. Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled: "This is impossible... The Seventh Generation has not passed, how can the Eighth Generation's shadow appear?" The figure stopped before Chen Ji, a slight smile on its lips: "Little brother... we finally meet."

Chen Ji's entire body stiffened, as if struck by thunder. That word—brother—exploded in his mind, bringing indescribable shock. He had never heard of having a brother, yet this man claiming to be his elder stood at fate's corridor's end, watching him with a complex gaze. What made Chen Ji's heart even more chilling was that the figure's aura, while identical to the Tianji Record Fragment, was more concentrated and complete. Ye Qing's voice sounded in his ear, filled with shock and fear: "Chen Ji... the Tianji Record aura on him is over ten times stronger than yours. Who is he?" Chen Ji did not answer; he merely stared fixedly at that face identical to his own, Chen Nian's vague features surfacing in his mind. The chessboard of fate was revealing its most terrifying side.
